title: Spider charts and cell drill-down with pre-registration outcomes

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Spider charts and cell drill-down show pre-registration outcomes

Scenario: Each cell on the site links back to its pre-registered verdict
  Given scored cells from studies/ with a signed shift, a 95% interval, and a pre-registered verdict
  When the leaderboard site renders the spider chart for an engine
  Then clicking a cell drills down to the pre-registration prediction, the observed shift and interval, and the verdict, matching studies/ byte for byte

right_now_summary: The site is adding spider charts and cell drill-downs that link each score to its pre-registered verdict.
